selection_rule: Datasets were screened for diversity of physical interaction and availability of time-aligned command and measured response; they were not selected to resemble specific LIBERO tasks.

candidates.name: DROID
candidates.robot_coverage: Franka Panda platform across many institutions, scenes, collectors, and tasks
measured_fields: collection/raw robot state code exposes motor torque and controller status but these are not present in the audited RLDS 1.0.0 schema
candidates.visual_fields: two exterior stereo-camera streams plus wrist stereo camera in the raw/RLDS data
candidates.time_information: robot and sensor timestamps are documented
caveats: Verify exact step alignment and which action field was sent to the controller for each release/configuration.
Do not interpret redundant derived command fields as independent ground truth.
The public policy-learning transform may convert actions to absolute representations; audit raw fields first.
The flattened RLDS action description is dimensionally ambiguous; use named action_dict fields only.

candidates.name: ManiSkill demonstrations
candidates.visual_fields: RGB/depth can be generated by trajectory replay
candidates.time_information: control configuration determines simulation step semantics; verify per task
caveats: Simulator data is not evidence of real-world transfer.
Replay with forced recorded states must not be mistaken for natural executed response.
Keep privileged object state out of deployable features.

candidates.name: RH20T
command_fields: arm command availability requires further verification
caveats: Do not train the command-response dynamics expert until the arm command channel is verified.
Large storage footprint requires a small schema sample before download.
Faces and voices may be present; do not inspect or redistribute sensitive content.

candidates.name: Open X-Embodiment
candidates.command_fields: varies by constituent dataset: absolute, delta, or velocity action semantics
caveats: RLDS unifies storage, not physical action semantics.
Each constituent dataset needs its own adapter and alignment audit.
Never concatenate all actions under one nominal seven-dimensional interpretation.

candidates.name: BridgeData V2
caveats: The currently located public material does not resolve command-versus-state semantics sufficiently for dynamics supervision.
Useful for policy or visual representation learning does not automatically mean valid for command-response learning.

candidates.name: robomimic/robosuite demonstrations
caveats: Shared robosuite controller and simulator family weakens claims of broad cross-domain generalization.
It is valuable for adapter validation but cannot be the sole external training evidence.
